svg.title: Top 5 Myths about Prisma ORM
svg.desc: A numbered list of the five myths the article debunks — Prisma ORM is slow, you can't use low-level DB features, it uses GraphQL under the hood, Prisma Client must live in node_modules, it doesn't work well with serverless — each line struck through in cyan on light paper.

g.text: You can't use low-level DB features
It uses GraphQL under the hood
Prisma Client must live in node_modules
It doesn't work well with serverless
